title: XBrain Presentation — JSON authoring contract v1.0
description: Canonical authoring format for release 1.0.0 and JSON schema 1.0. The importer requires version 1.0 for documents; raw slide arrays are normalized to a v1 document. Selectors and CSS variables use the v1 namespace. Validation does not sanitize author-provided HTML/SVG/CSS or prove visual fit.
$comment: The HTML runtime remains a standalone file and does not fetch or automatically enforce this schema.

helpers.description: Shared helpers: JS expression strings (or arrays of lines); other JSON values are used as-is.

row.description: A data row: string, number, or mapping. Named fields belong to the dataset, not the slide schema.

dataset.description: Inline rows, serialized JSON/CSV text, or a typed source definition.

transform.description: Applied in order: filter, sort, limit, group and sum. aggregateField defaults to value.

position.description: Absolute pixels in the composer scene; x or y activates positioning. Missing coordinate defaults to 0; width/height default to 520/340.

edge.description: Accepted graph metadata; current native diagram renderers do not use edges to route connections.

component.description: One registered composer component. Children/components recurse through this same contract. Fields are optional unless explicitly required; renderer defaults still apply.
